history: Hefei was ancient Luzhou, a Three Kingdoms battleground where Zhang Liao stunned the east at Xiaoyao Ford. It is the hometown of Bao Zheng, the just Judge Bao. Today it is a comprehensive national science center — the 'artificial sun' of USTC and quantum communication went global from here.
importance: Capital of Anhui · Comprehensive National Science Center
foods: Crispy duck with sweet sauce — the old Hefei flavor.
Fried rice-flour shells with shrimp and tofu filling.
Braised goose, salty and savory — Chaohu specialty.
Chaohu loach stewed with dried noodles — pure countryside.
Ningguo Road's crayfish street glows all night.
Duck-fat pastry with sesame — warm, yellow and crispy.
Traditional crisp candy with osmanthus sweetness.
Silverfish scrambled with eggs — the lake's taste.
scenes: The ancient battlefield where Zhang Liao stunned Xiaoyao Ford.
Lord Bao's shrine and Qingfeng Pavilion — justice incarnate.
Science Island's 'artificial sun' under cherry blossoms.
A 2,500-year water town with its 'eight ancient' sights.
The Chu ding bronze and cloud-patterned vessels.
City lake views and sunset silhouettes.
A food street famous for 'clink the jar' toasts.
An extinct-volcano forest park in the city.
